data.body: **P2:** This barrier still runs only from try-with-resources cleanup, after `DurableExecutor` constructs `InvocationEndInfo` and calls `onInvocationEnd`. Until then `closing` remains false, so an admitted READY continuation can run or dispatch another predicate/checkpoint while plugins are finalizing; the OTel plugin may therefore end and flush its root before later operation/user-function hooks, and its operation snapshot can be stale. Add an explicit admission-close/drain phase that `DurableExecutor` invokes before `fireOnInvocationEnd`, then perform checkpoint shutdown afterward. Cover the real executor lifecycle by asserting no hooks or operation changes occur after invocation end.
